checks.summary: V2-019-reconciler.json's check named a12-stop-mode-by-kind-matrix records in its summary: 'Allowed-cell totals: allow=8/8, pause-intake=2/8 (capture, checkpoint), pause-claim=2/8 (capture, checkpoint), graceful-stop=1/8 (checkpoint only), immediate-stop/emergency-stop/cancel=0/8 each (13/56 total)'. That pause-intake figure and total are wrong: the matrix drives Capture as domain.PermitIntake, and pause-intake's per-kind gate (permitAllowedTable) denies exactly PermitIntake, so Capture is denied under pause-intake, not allowed; the correct pause-intake count is 1/8 (checkpoint only), correct total 12/56 (this task's own measurement, see V2-059-application.json). V2-019-reconciler.json itself is not edited under this Work Order; it belongs to another task and per A12 is left for whoever next refreshes it. This note exists so the wrong prose is not cited again.
